1.name: Female Black Duck & White Mallard
1.desc: I wasn't sure quite sure what species the white duck is, it may be some domestic breed, but I figured white mallard was the best fit.

2.name: Immature Glaucous Gull
2.desc: Very photogenic. Very difficult to ID in her immaturity.

3.name: Greater Yellow Legs
3.desc: Something about this one is very meditative. I love watching these guys walk around.

4.name: Semi Palmated Plover
4.desc: These guys love chasing the wave as it receeds and then flying away in a locus-esque swarm when it floods it. Highly entertaining to watch.

5.name: Cedar Waxwing
5.desc: One of the prettiest birds I've ever seen. Their waxy texture is something that needs to be seen in person.
